questions.question: Use filter_by_category with field equal to uses_ai, values equal to No and use highlight_category with field equal to uses_ai, values equal to Yes and use hide_dimensions with dimensions equal to study_hours_per_day, daily_screen_time_hours, mode equal to hide in order to know How does AI usage affect student academic performance across different dimensions?

answer.value: AI usage has a significant positive impact on student academic performance. Students who use AI showed substantial improvement in grades, increasing from 0.516 to 0.593 (14.8% improvement), while non-AI users experienced a dramatic decline from 0.470 to 0.276 (41.2% decline). The final average grade for AI users (0.593) is more than double that of non-AI users (0.276), representing a 0.316 difference. In terms of study habits, AI users have slightly lower study hours (0.458 vs 0.523) but higher screen time (0.495 vs 0.450), suggesting AI may help compensate for less study time. The data reveals a clear pattern: AI usage correlates with better academic outcomes, with AI users maintaining or improving their performance while non-AI users struggle significantly.

Final grades of AI users (0.593) are more than double non-AI users (0.276)
